headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 21, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins suffered a blowout loss in Cleveland, falling 13-4 to the Guardians. Petey Halpin led the Twins' offense with 3-for-5 performance and 2 home runs. In other action, the New York Yankees secured a 5-8 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 5 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Max Meyer has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a neck strain, effective retroactive to July 19, 2026. Phil Maton has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right knee tendinitis, while Miguel Andujar is out with a right wrist fracture. Adley Rutschman has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left wrist inflammation, and Will Vest has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with right posterior elbow inflammation.

The Los Angeles Dodgers made a trade with the Colorado Rockies, acquiring right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen in exchange for right-handed pitcher Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek. The Chicago Cubs also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett.

top_news.title: **Twins Suffer Blowout Loss in Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins fell to the Cleveland Guardians 13-4, with Petey Halpin leading the Twins' offense going 3-for-5 with 2 home runs and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Yankees in 8-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-8 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 5 RBIs. Wilber Dotel pitched 3 scoreless innings for the Pirates, striking out 5 batters.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Blue Jays 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 7-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Nick Fortes leading the offense. Fortes hit a home run on a fly ball to left center field, contributing to the Rays' win.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Edge Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, coming from behind to take the win. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Max Meyer Placed on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Miami Marlins right-hander Max Meyer has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a neck strain, effective retroactive to July 19, 2026.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Acquire Halvorsen in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for right-handed pitcher Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek. The trade was completed on July 20, 2026.
